facts.finding: Actual captured document identifies Version IX, resolving the earlier VIII/IX retrieval ambiguity for this capture. Every commodity mapping still requires separate validation.

Clause 1(2) explicitly specifies 1 December 2026. Do not activate the May amendments on 2 November. Preserve the correct December date already in batch47; an unrelated January 2027 guard does not override this source.

The direction keeps the earlier coffee-chicory notification in abeyance. Revised front-of-pack coffee/chicory percentage declarations have a minimum 1 mm font height, or 2 mm where PDP exceeds 100 cm². Paragraph 3 sets 1 July 2027. All other applicable labelling requirements remain separately applicable.
